summary.text: Melissa Oropeza is a Democratic state representative who has represented Kansas House District 37 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A nurse practitioner, she holds a doctorate in nursing practice.

paragraphs.text: Oropeza was born in Wyandotte County, Kansas.

She earned an associate degree from Kansas City Kansas Community College, bachelor's and master's degrees in nursing from the University of Kansas, and a doctorate in nursing practice from the University of Missouri at Kansas City.
Her career experience includes working as a nurse practitioner.
Oropeza took office in the Kansas House on January 9, 2023, succeeding Representative Aaron Coleman.
During the 2025-2026 session she served on the Health and Human Services and Legislative Modernization committees and as ranking minority member of the Social Services Budget Committee.
